modules.documentation: CPU tensor lifecycle and scalar metadata through LibTorch's stable C ABI.

types.name: Tensor
types.documentation: An owned LibTorch tensor handle disposed exactly once.

types.name: TorchScriptModel
types.documentation: A loaded thread-confined TorchScript module disposed exactly once.

types.name: TensorPair
types.documentation: An owned two-tensor TorchScript output container disposed exactly once.

functions.name: from_int
functions.documentation: Creates a scalar int64 tensor.

functions.name: from_float
functions.documentation: Creates a scalar float64 tensor.

functions.name: from_bool
functions.documentation: Creates a scalar bool tensor.

functions.name: from_floats
functions.documentation: Copies row-major float64 values into an independently owned CPU tensor with the requested shape.

functions.name: from_ints
functions.documentation: Copies row-major int64 values into an independently owned CPU tensor with the requested shape.

functions.name: full_float
functions.documentation: Creates a CPU float64 tensor with the requested shape and repeated value.

functions.name: item
functions.documentation: Reads the scalar int64 item.

functions.name: item_float
functions.documentation: Reads the scalar float64 item.

functions.name: item_bool
functions.documentation: Reads the scalar bool item.

functions.name: dim
functions.documentation: Returns the tensor rank.

functions.name: numel
functions.documentation: Returns the tensor element count.

functions.name: shape
functions.documentation: Immediately copies LibTorch's borrowed size array into an owned Terlan list.

functions.name: dtype
functions.documentation: Returns LibTorch's runtime dtype identifier.

functions.name: device_type
functions.documentation: Returns LibTorch's runtime device type identifier.

functions.name: device_index
functions.documentation: Returns the device index.

functions.name: clone
functions.documentation: Clones a tensor through LibTorch's versioned StableIValue dispatcher.

functions.name: unsqueeze
functions.documentation: Inserts a dimension through a signed StableIValue dispatcher argument.

functions.name: matmul
functions.documentation: Multiplies two tensors through independently owned StableIValue handle inputs.

functions.name: transpose
functions.documentation: Transposes two dimensions through a named overload and mixed StableIValue stack.

functions.name: multiply
functions.documentation: Multiplies two tensors through the exact named Tensor dispatcher overload.

functions.name: add
functions.documentation: Adds a scaled tensor with CPU broadcasting through LibTorch's generated stable C shim.

functions.name: subtract
functions.documentation: Subtracts a scaled tensor through LibTorch's generated stable C shim.

functions.name: relu
functions.documentation: Applies the exact default aten::relu operation through the StableIValue dispatcher.

functions.name: gelu
functions.documentation: Applies exact aten::gelu with the fixed approximate=none schema default through an owned stable string.

functions.name: softmax
functions.documentation: Normalizes logits through the exact aten::softmax.int dispatcher overload with inherited dtype.

functions.name: argmax
functions.documentation: Returns int64 maximum-value indices through the exact aten::argmax schema, including its owned optional dimension and boolean keep-dimension arguments.

functions.name: embedding
functions.documentation: Looks up int64 indices in a rank-2 embedding table through exact aten::embedding.

functions.name: batch_norm
functions.documentation: Applies exact aten::batch_norm with explicit affine parameters and running statistics.

functions.name: layer_norm
functions.documentation: Applies exact aten::layer_norm over an owned normalized-shape list with explicit affine parameters.

functions.name: mse_loss
functions.documentation: Computes elementwise squared error through exact aten::mse_loss; reduction is 0 for none, 1 for mean, or 2 for sum.

functions.name: mse_loss_gradient
functions.documentation: Computes the exact aten::mse_loss_backward gradient with respect to predicted values.

functions.name: cross_entropy_loss
functions.documentation: Computes classification loss through exact aten::cross_entropy_loss with no class-weight tensor.

functions.name: narrow
functions.documentation: Returns an independently owned narrowed tensor view through LibTorch's generated stable C shim.

functions.name: flatten
functions.documentation: Flattens an inclusive dimension range through the exact named StableIValue dispatcher overload.

functions.name: amax
functions.documentation: Reduces over copied dimensions through LibTorch's generated stable C amax shim.

functions.name: conv2d
functions.documentation: Applies NCHW 2D convolution with required bias through LibTorch's generated CPU stable C shim.

functions.name: adaptive_avg_pool2d
functions.documentation: Reduces NCHW spatial dimensions to an exact output size through LibTorch's generated CPU adaptive-average-pooling shim.

functions.name: load_torchscript
functions.documentation: Loads a serialized TorchScript archive into a reusable thread-confined model resource.

functions.name: torchscript_forward
functions.documentation: Runs a loaded single-input TorchScript model and returns an independently owned tensor.

functions.name: torchscript_forward2
functions.documentation: Runs a loaded two-positional-tensor TorchScript model and returns an independently owned tensor.

functions.name: torchscript_forward_pair
functions.documentation: Runs a loaded model whose forward result is exactly a two-tensor tuple and owns that result container.

functions.name: torchscript_forward_float
functions.documentation: Runs a loaded model whose forward result is exactly a TorchScript float and copies it into Terlan.

functions.name: torchscript_forward_int
functions.documentation: Runs a loaded model whose forward result is exactly a TorchScript integer and copies it into Terlan.

functions.name: torchscript_forward_bool
functions.documentation: Runs a loaded model whose forward result is exactly a TorchScript boolean and copies it into Terlan.

functions.name: torchscript_forward_string
functions.documentation: Runs a loaded model whose forward result is exactly a TorchScript string and immediately copies its owned UTF-8 bytes into Terlan.

functions.name: torchscript_forward_int_list
functions.documentation: Runs a loaded model whose forward result is exactly a TorchScript integer list and immediately copies its owned elements into Terlan.

functions.name: torchscript_forward_float_list
functions.documentation: Runs a loaded model whose forward result is exactly a TorchScript floating-point list and immediately copies its owned elements into Terlan.

functions.name: torchscript_forward_bool_list
functions.documentation: Runs a loaded model whose forward result is exactly a TorchScript boolean list, validates its portable byte encoding, and copies it into Terlan.

functions.name: torchscript_forward_string_list
functions.documentation: Runs a loaded model whose forward result is exactly a TorchScript string list and copies each length-delimited UTF-8 value into Terlan before native destruction.

functions.name: tensor_pair_first
functions.documentation: Returns an independently owned handle for the first tensor in a model-output pair.

functions.name: tensor_pair_second
functions.documentation: Returns an independently owned handle for the second tensor in a model-output pair.

functions.name: run_torchscript
functions.documentation: Loads, runs, and disposes a TorchScript module as a stateless convenience call.

functions.name: dispose_model
functions.documentation: Releases the loaded TorchScript model resource.

functions.name: dispose_tensor_pair
functions.documentation: Releases the owned two-tensor model-output container.

functions.name: dispose
functions.documentation: Releases the owned tensor handle.

functions.name: abi_version
functions.documentation: Returns the LibTorch ABI version exported by the runtime.
